inv.desc_en:
SALESMAN INVESTMENT SELLS RENTED PREMISES TO A VERY SOLVENT COMPANY NET CAP RATE 5.5%, Attention investors! We present an exceptional corner commercial premises, located in a strategic location with high vehicular traffic. This space has 100 m² built and 72 m² useful, offering unparalleled versatility thanks to its generous height. Its impressive 20 linear meter facade and four large display windows guarantee unbeatable visibility. Equipped with air conditioning and heating, it provides a comfortable environment for both employees and customers. 6.2% Net profitability, from the moment you buy.

Currently rented to a solvent company with extensive experience, these premises are a safe and profitable investment. In case it becomes vacant, its attractiveness and location facilitate its rapid occupation. Furthermore, it has a bathroom and an office area, which increases its functionality. Don't miss the opportunity to acquire a high-demand asset in the market. Contact us for more information and secure your future with this real estate gem!
